title: Recognizing the Gods
scope: South Asian Hindu, Jain and Buddhist iconographic hand gestures
limitations: General South Asian iconographic vocabulary; does not identify the user's exact photographed statues or museum.

title: Sri Lankan Buddha collection records: vitarka and abhaya mudras
scope: Sri Lankan Buddha sculpture from Anuradhapura/Polonnaruwa through Kandy
limitations: Collection records demonstrate Sri Lankan use of selected gestures, not a complete local taxonomy.

title: IN03104 Polonnaruva Gal-Vihara Rock Inscription of Parakkama-Bahu I
author_or_institution: Siddham / ERC Beyond Boundaries; edition after D. M. de Z. Wickremasinghe
scope: Twelfth-century Gal Vihara monastic ordinance and historical introduction
limitations: Royal/monastic normative inscription; establishes regulation and reform programme rather than neutral social outcomes.

title: Rewriting Buddhism: Pali Literature and Monastic Reform in Sri Lanka, 1157–1270
scope: Intellectual and institutional history of Sri Lankan monastic reform and Pali literary production, 1157–1270
limitations: Interpretive scholarly synthesis; causal relationship between reform and literary production is argued from textual history rather than a single contemporaneous record.

title: IN03166 Gadaladeniya Rock-Inscription of Dharmmakirtti Sthavira
author_or_institution: Siddham / ERC Beyond Boundaries; edition by Senarath Paranavitana
scope: Foundation of Gadaladeniya Buddhist shrine under Bhuvanaikabahu IV in 1344
limitations: Supports Gadaladeniya specifically; does not by itself establish all Gampola-period temples or a generalized religious revival.

title: Understanding the education system in the Kotte period of Sri Lanka through Sandesha Kavya
author_or_institution: R. A. A. S. Ranaweera et al., University of Kelaniya / Journal of Multidisciplinary and Translational Research
scope: Kotte-period pirivena education, Sandesha poetry, royal and monastic literary patronage
limitations: Recent secondary study relying substantially on literary sources; 'golden age' is historiographical framing rather than a measured output series.

title: History of Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte
scope: Institutional local history of Kotte, literary works and religious institutions
limitations: Public-history synthesis contains inconsistent royal numbering in places; used only as corroboration for the broad literary-flourishing claim.

title: Basawakkulama weva
scope: Current institutional presentation of the 'Wavai dagabai' tank-and-dagaba cultural concept
limitations: Evidence for modern heritage discourse, not for the antiquity, exact age or uninterrupted use of the phrase.
